\section{Experiments}
\label{sec:experiments}

\subsection{Setup}
\label{sec:exp-setup}

We evaluate SICA against Self-Consistency (SC) across six models on three reasoning domains with over 3,000 condition-evaluations across ${\sim}$1,250 unique instances. Beyond accuracy comparisons, we conduct diagnostic analyses of symbolic confirmation bias and process-level trace independence (\S\ref{sec:analysis}).

\paragraph{Models.} Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B (non-thinking mode)~\citep{yang2024qwen25}, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3~\citep{jiang2023mistral}, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct~\citep{dubey2024llama3}, and QwQ-32B~\citep{qwen2024qwq} (7B--32B parameters).

\paragraph{Datasets.} FOLIO~\citep{han2022folio} ($n{=}204$, with gold logical annotations), ProofWriter depth-5~\citep{tafjord2021proofwriter} ($n{=}600$), LogiQA~\citep{liu2020logiqa} ($n{=}200$). StrategyQA~\citep{geva2021strategyqa} ($n{=}200$) serves as a domain-formalizability diagnostic. GSM8K~\citep{cobbe2021gsm8k} ($n{=}30$) and AIME 2024 ($n{=}22$) probe the degenerate regime ($C_0 < 5\%$).

\paragraph{Parameters.} $K{=}12$ traces at $T{=}0.7$; extraction at $T_{\text{ext}}{=}0.3$. Z3 timeout: 10s. $\alpha{=}0.5$. Statistical significance via McNemar exact test ($\alpha{=}0.05$); 95\% bootstrap CIs from 10,000 resamples for $n \geq 200$.

\paragraph{Computational cost.} On Mistral-7B FOLIO ($K{=}12$), SICA takes $4.5{\times}$ SC wall-clock time; constraint extraction ($K$ additional LLM calls) accounts for 76\% of overhead, Z3 solving is negligible (${<}0.1\%$).


\subsection{Main Results}
\label{sec:main-results}

Table~\ref{tab:main_results} reports accuracy across all conditions sorted by SC baseline. We identify three empirical regimes (thresholds observation-driven, not theoretically derived). SICA effectiveness depends sharply on this accuracy regime.

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{SICA vs.\ SC across all conditions sorted by SC accuracy. Results hold across the full capability range: from Mistral-7B (54.41\% SC) to Qwen3-14B thinking mode (86.27\% SC), SICA delivers no significant gain. $\Delta$ = SICA $-$ SC (pp). $^b$In-context learning with gold logical examples. $\dagger$\,$n < 100$ (suggestive only). \textbf{Bold $\Delta$}: $p < 0.05$ (McNemar). {*}\,$p < 0.05$;\enspace{**}\,$p < 0.01$;\enspace{***}\,$p < 0.001$. Failure modes detailed in Appendix~\ref{app:failure-modes}. $^{4s}$\,4-seed replication (confirmatory); unmarked single-seed conditions are exploratory.}
\label{tab:main_results}
\begin{tabular}{@{}llrrrrl@{}}
\toprule
Model & Domain & $n$ & SC (\%) & SICA (\%) & $\Delta$ (pp) & $p$ \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{7}{l}{\textit{Type C: error amplification (SC $\leq$ 40\%)}} \\
Mistral-7B & PW-D5 & 600 & 39.33 & 36.50 & $\mathbf{-2.83}$ & 0.014{*} \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{7}{l}{\textit{Intermediate SC (SC $\sim$50--55\%, Mistral-7B only)}} \\
Mistral-7B & LogiQA & 200 & 51.00 & 51.50 & $+$0.50 & 1.000 \\
Mistral-7B & FOLIO (s123) & 204 & 54.41 & 57.35 & $+$2.94 & 0.070 \\
Mistral-7B$^{4s}$ & FOLIO & 204 & 55.88 & 59.31 & $+$3.43 & 0.092 \\
Mistral-7B & FOLIO (s456) & 204 & 55.88 & 55.88 & 0.00 & 1.000 \\
Mistral-7B & FOLIO (s789) & 204 & 54.41 & 53.92 & $-$0.49 & 1.000 \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{7}{l}{\textit{Type A: confirmation bias (SC $\geq$ 60\%)}} \\
LLaMA-3.1-8B & FOLIO & 204 & 66.18 & 61.76 & $-$4.41 & 0.093 \\
LLaMA-3.1-8B & StrategyQA & 200 & 72.00 & 74.00 & $+$2.00 & 0.424 \\
Qwen2.5-14B & FOLIO (ICL)$^b$ & 199 & 74.37 & 74.87 & $+$0.50 & 1.000 \\
Qwen2.5-14B & PW-D5 & 600 & 75.17 & 72.67 & $\mathbf{-2.50}$ & 0.011{*} \\
Qwen2.5-14B & FOLIO & 204 & 75.49 & 74.51 & $-$0.98 & 1.000 \\
Qwen2.5-7B & FOLIO & 204 & 75.98 & 76.47 & $+$0.49 & 1.000 \\
Qwen2.5-14B & LogiQA & 200 & 78.50 & 78.00 & $-$0.50 & 1.000 \\
Qwen3-14B & FOLIO & 204 & 84.80 & 84.31 & $-$0.49 & 1.000 \\
Qwen3-14B & PW-D5 & 600 & 85.00 & 85.67 & $+$0.67 & 1.000 \\
Qwen3-14B (think) & FOLIO & 204 & 86.27 & 86.76 & $+$0.49 & 1.000 \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{7}{l}{\textit{Degenerate ($C_0 < 5\%$)}} \\
QwQ-32B & AIME 2024$^\dagger$ & 22 & 72.70 & 72.70 & 0.00 & \textrm{---} \\
Qwen2.5-14B & GSM8K$^\dagger$ & 30 & 96.67 & 96.67 & 0.00 & \textrm{---} \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{7}{l}{\textit{Oracle upper bound (gold logical annotations + Z3)}} \\
Mistral-7B & FOLIO & 204 & 55.88 & \textbf{85.78} & $\mathbf{+29.90}$ & $1.0{\times}10^{-13}${***} \\
Qwen2.5-14B & FOLIO & 204 & 75.49 & \textbf{89.71} & $\mathbf{+14.22}$ & $2.0{\times}10^{-7}${***} \\
Qwen2.5-14B & ProofWriter & 600 & 75.17 & \textbf{86.67} & $\mathbf{+11.50}$ & $9.21{\times}10^{-15}${***} \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}

None of sixteen non-degenerate conditions shows a significant positive effect. Two show significant degradation: Mistral-7B on ProofWriter ($-2.83$\,pp, $p = 0.014$) and Qwen2.5-14B on ProofWriter ($-2.50$\,pp, $p = 0.011$). The intermediate-SC region (50--55\%) contains the only positive trends, none reaching $p < 0.05$. TOST equivalence tests \citep{lakens2017equivalence} ($\pm 2$\,pp) establish equivalence for 4 conditions; 5 show genuine differences (4 negative); 6 are underpowered (Appendix~\ref{app:tost}). We trace the failure to three mechanisms in \S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}--\S\ref{sec:remediation}.


\subsection{Oracle Control}
\label{sec:oracle}

Oracle variants replace self-extracted constraints with gold annotations: logical formulae from FOLIO ($n = 204$) and DSL from ProofWriter ($n = 600$). Oracle-SICA yields $+29.90$\,pp on Mistral-7B FOLIO ($p < 10^{-13}$), $+14.22$\,pp on Qwen2.5-14B FOLIO ($p = 2.0 \times 10^{-7}$), and $+11.50$\,pp on ProofWriter ($p < 10^{-14}$). Z3 agrees with gold labels on 95.1\% (FOLIO) and 97.1\% (ProofWriter) of problems. The MAX-SAT mechanism is sound; Mistral-7B's best self-extracted result ($+3.43$\,pp) captures only 11.5\% of its oracle ceiling, with ${\sim}$88\% lost to extraction quality.

import json
import numpy as np

conditions = [
    {"model": "Mistral-7B",          "dataset": "PW-D5",           "n": 600, "sc": 39.33, "sica": 36.50, "delta": -2.83, "raw_p": 0.014},
    {"model": "Mistral-7B",          "dataset": "LogiQA",          "n": 200, "sc": 51.00, "sica": 51.50, "delta":  0.50, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Mistral-7B",          "dataset": "FOLIO (s123)",    "n": 204, "sc": 54.41, "sica": 57.35, "delta":  2.94, "raw_p": 0.070},
    {"model": "Mistral-7B (4s)",     "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 55.88, "sica": 59.31, "delta":  3.43, "raw_p": 0.092},
    {"model": "Mistral-7B",          "dataset": "FOLIO (s456)",    "n": 204, "sc": 55.88, "sica": 55.88, "delta":  0.00, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Mistral-7B",          "dataset": "FOLIO (s789)",    "n": 204, "sc": 54.41, "sica": 53.92, "delta": -0.49, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "LLaMA-3.1-8B",       "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 66.18, "sica": 61.76, "delta": -4.41, "raw_p": 0.093},
    {"model": "LLaMA-3.1-8B",       "dataset": "StrategyQA",      "n": 200, "sc": 72.00, "sica": 74.00, "delta":  2.00, "raw_p": 0.424},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5-14B",        "dataset": "FOLIO (ICL)",     "n": 199, "sc": 74.37, "sica": 74.87, "delta":  0.50, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5-14B",        "dataset": "PW-D5",           "n": 600, "sc": 75.17, "sica": 72.67, "delta": -2.50, "raw_p": 0.011},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5-14B",        "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 75.49, "sica": 74.51, "delta": -0.98, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5-7B",         "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 75.98, "sica": 76.47, "delta":  0.49, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen2.5-14B",        "dataset": "LogiQA",          "n": 200, "sc": 78.50, "sica": 78.00, "delta": -0.50, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen3-14B",          "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 84.80, "sica": 84.31, "delta": -0.49, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen3-14B",          "dataset": "PW-D5",           "n": 600, "sc": 85.00, "sica": 85.67, "delta":  0.67, "raw_p": 1.000},
    {"model": "Qwen3-14B (think)",   "dataset": "FOLIO",           "n": 204, "sc": 86.27, "sica": 86.76, "delta":  0.49, "raw_p": 1.000},
]

m = len(conditions)
assert m == 16

raw_ps = np.array([c["raw_p"] for c in conditions])

# BH correction
sorted_indices = np.argsort(raw_ps)
sorted_p = raw_ps[sorted_indices]

adjusted = np.zeros(m)
for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
    raw_adj = sorted_p[i] * m / (i + 1)
    if i == m - 1:
        adjusted[i] = min(raw_adj, 1.0)
    else:
        adjusted[i] = min(adjusted[i + 1], min(raw_adj, 1.0))

# Map back to original order
adj_p = np.zeros(m)
for i, idx in enumerate(sorted_indices):
    adj_p[idx] = adjusted[i]

# Also verify with scipy if available
try:
    from scipy.stats import false_discovery_control
    # scipy doesn't have BH directly as adjusted p-values, let's use statsmodels
    raise ImportError
except ImportError:
    pass

try:
    from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
    reject, pvals_corrected, _, _ = multipletests(raw_ps, alpha=0.05, method='fdr_bh')
    print("=== Scipy/statsmodels verification ===")
    for i in range(m):
        match = "OK" if abs(adj_p[i] - pvals_corrected[i]) < 1e-10 else "MISMATCH"
        if match == "MISMATCH":
            print(f"  {conditions[i]['model']:20s} {conditions[i]['dataset']:15s}  mine={adj_p[i]:.6f}  sm={pvals_corrected[i]:.6f}  {match}")
    if all(abs(adj_p[i] - pvals_corrected[i]) < 1e-10 for i in range(m)):
        print("  All values match statsmodels.\n")
except ImportError:
    print("(statsmodels not available for cross-check)\n")

# Build output
alpha = 0.05
output_conditions = []
for i, c in enumerate(conditions):
    entry = {
        "model": c["model"],
        "dataset": c["dataset"],
        "n": c["n"],
        "sc_pct": c["sc"],
        "sica_pct": c["sica"],
        "delta_pp": c["delta"],
        "raw_p": c["raw_p"],
        "adjusted_p": round(adj_p[i], 6),
        "significant_raw": c["raw_p"] < alpha,
        "significant_bh": adj_p[i] < alpha
    }
    output_conditions.append(entry)

n_sig_raw = sum(1 for c in output_conditions if c["significant_raw"])
n_sig_bh = sum(1 for c in output_conditions if c["significant_bh"])
losing = [f"{c['model']} / {c['dataset']} (raw={c['raw_p']}, adj={c['adjusted_p']:.4f})"
          for c in output_conditions if c["significant_raw"] and not c["significant_bh"]]

result = {
    "m": m,
    "alpha": alpha,
    "method": "Benjamini-Hochberg",
    "conditions": output_conditions,
    "summary": {
        "n_significant_raw": n_sig_raw,
        "n_significant_bh": n_sig_bh,
        "conditions_losing_significance": losing
    }
}

# Save JSON
outpath = "artifacts/table1_bh_correction.json"
with open(outpath, "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
print(f"Saved to {outpath}\n")

# Print table
print(f"{'Model':<22s} {'Dataset':<16s} {'Δ(pp)':>7s} {'raw p':>8s} {'adj p':>8s} {'raw sig':>8s} {'BH sig':>8s}")
print("-" * 93)
for c in output_conditions:
    raw_sig = "*" if c["significant_raw"] else ""
    bh_sig = "*" if c["significant_bh"] else ""
    print(f"{c['model']:<22s} {c['dataset']:<16s} {c['delta_pp']:>+7.2f} {c['raw_p']:>8.4f} {c['adjusted_p']:>8.4f} {raw_sig:>8s} {bh_sig:>8s}")

print(f"\nSignificant at α=0.05:  raw={n_sig_raw}, BH-corrected={n_sig_bh}")
print(f"Conditions losing significance after BH correction:")
for l in losing:
    print(f"  - {l}")
